Assurance.description:
What kind of assurance the FI holds about the provider.

MAS-AIRM §5.11(a) accepts "certifications or external assessments of the AI provider performed
by independent and competent parties (i.e. not self-attestations)". Response to Feedback §9.9
is explicit that self-attestation unsupported by evidence "would generally not be considered as
effective". :meth:`is_independent` encodes exactly that line.
Assurance.title: Assurance

Consideration.description:
The eight third-party considerations MAS-AIRM §5.11 lists.

Response to Feedback §9.5 confirms each "may be met to varying degrees depending on the nature
and risk materiality of the AI use case", which is why each carries a status rather than a
pass/fail.
Consideration.title: Consideration

ConsiderationRecord.description: The FI's finding on one §5.11 consideration.

finding.description: What the FI found, in its own words.
finding.title: Finding

compensating_controls.description: Controls applied where the consideration is not fully met, e.g. additional testing on the FI's own data or greater human oversight (MAS-AIRM §5.11(a), Response §9.10).
compensating_controls.title: Compensating Controls

ConsiderationRecord.title: ConsiderationRecord

ConsiderationStatus.description: How far a §5.11 consideration has been met.
ConsiderationStatus.title: ConsiderationStatus

Decision.description:
The onboarding or continuation decision.

MAS-AIRM §5.11: where residual risk materiality cannot be kept within appetite, "the FI should
consider limiting or suspending the third-party AI service, or replacing the relevant
third-party provider".
Decision.title: Decision

VendorAssessment.description:
An assessment of one third-party AI provider or component.

Serves MAS-AIRM §5.10-§5.11. The assessment is per provider-component-use-case triple, because
§5.10 requires testing "in the context of the FI's use cases (including using the FI's own
data)": the same model assessed for one use case is not thereby assessed for another.

embedded.description: AI inside a service not marketed as AI (MAS-AIRM §4.2 fn21).
embedded.title: Embedded

material_provider.description: Material third-party service provider per the FI's own register (§4.2).
material_provider.title: Material Provider

assurance_scope.description: Which AI risks the certification or external assessment covers. §5.11(a) expects coverage of key risks; a certificate of unknown scope is not assurance.
assurance_scope.title: Assurance Scope

assurance_body.description: Who performed the assessment, for the independence test.
assurance_body.title: Assurance Body

fi_testing_done.description: FI tested the component on its own data and use case (MAS-AIRM §5.10).
fi_testing_done.title: Fi Testing Done

residual_within_appetite.description: Per MAS-AIRM §5.11; the FI's own determination.
residual_within_appetite.title: Residual Within Appetite

VendorAssessment.title: VendorAssessment

description:
A collection of vendor assessments.

Supports the concentration view MAS-AIRM §5.11(c) and §3.4 footnote 18 ask for, across
providers rather than within one use case.
title: VendorRegister
